name: PhD Program in Cancer Engineering
institution: Gerstner Sloan Kettering Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences
detailsNote: Official information available. The application opens August 15, 2026 and closes December 1 'of the year prior to entry'; the pages do not name Fall 2027 outright, so the December 1, 2026 date follows from that wording. The TOEFL score needed is not stated.
summary: Gerstner Sloan Kettering PhD in cancer engineering. Students do not commit to a lab when they start and explore potential mentors during the first-year curriculum.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: Apply page: 'December 1 of the year prior to entry'; FAQ: application opens August 15, 2026, with submission deadline December 1.

timeline.interviews: Applicants under serious consideration are invited to interview. The in-person requirement may be waived if geographical constraints are overwhelming.

english.note: Official TOEFL scores are required, with exceptions such as a US bachelor's or master's degree. No minimum score is stated.

documents: Official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions (non-encrypted PDF)
Letters of recommendation from advisors and/or research mentors, submitted online
requirements.note: GPA and grades must be on a 4.0 scale.

funding.note: All matriculated students receive a fellowship package: stipend, a tuition scholarship covering tuition and fees, and yearly continuation with satisfactory progress. Students who win certain competitive predoctoral fellowships receive an additional $5,000.

international.note: FAQ: 'Yes, we do accept international students.' Visa help is given once accepted.
